notes: Nine items queued from the 2026-09-10 poll, all nine read. Every Registry article is cut off by a subscription wall after the lede.

coverage.note: The OpenAI, Newsom and FivePoint stories name San Francisco addresses only in the related-articles rail. The Steph Curry story names a private individual in its headline and its address sits behind the paywall, so it is not written up. Candlestick's groundbreaking names no single parcel.

findings.description: Pendulum Property Partners acquired 747 Front Street for $49 million through foreclosure; the visible lede puts the price at roughly $600 per square foot. The buyer, price and mechanism are in the headline. The date of the transfer is behind the paywall, so the entry takes the article's date.
